name: Ko-fi Alerts
description: A Ko-fi tip lands on your stream as an alert: who sent it and how much, written the way you write money, with a sound, a spoken line and a message in chat. It shows inside every overlay you have in OBS. Installs the alert and connects Ko-fi: paste the verification token from Ko-fi's webhooks page and the link this gives you back, then send yourself a test tip and watch it land.
changelog: First release: Ko-fi alerts as a product of their own.
ready_message: Your Ko-fi alert is built and listening for tips.
notes: A test tip from Ko-fi's webhooks page travels the whole way, so it proves more than anything Overlabels could fake.
Once Ko-fi is connected, its tip counter and latest donor are controls of yours for any overlay you write: [[[c:kofi:donations_received]]] and [[[c:kofi:latest_donor_name]]].
